title: Tool Capsule Expert Elicitation
description: Capture an expert method as review-gated reasoning devices, traps, precedents, salience priors, and output rules.

stages.title: Walkthrough
question_templates: Walk me through how you apply this method to a hard case.
What do you check first, before you trust the rest of the analysis?

follow_up_hints.prompt: Give the last real case where this step changed your judgment.

stages.title: Devices And Heuristics
question_templates: Name the mental moves or devices you use.
For each device, when should PRAXIS apply it and what evidence does it need?
completion_criteria: Each device has a failure condition.

stages.title: Traps
question_templates: What does everyone get wrong with this method?
What false confidence should the assistant refuse?
completion_criteria: At least three traps are named.
Refusal or caveat language is provided.

stages.title: Precedents And Failure Cases
question_templates: Give me a success case, a failure case, and the lesson from each.
Which precedent should PRAXIS not over-analogize from?
completion_criteria: At least two precedents are captured.
At least one anti-analogy is captured.

stages.title: Output Contract
question_templates: What should a good output look like after this tool is applied?
What must the assistant cite, hedge, or refuse?

criteria.description: Complete-enough Tool protocols need at least eight devices or heuristics.
At least three traps or failure modes must be captured.
At least two precedents or analogies must be captured.
